note: A reason is a claim with preconditions. Round-8 review, all three models: checking that a path exists and that a reason is non-empty is syntactic validity, not semantic validity. Each code below names what it asserts and what must be present for the assertion to be checkable; each code also names the risk classes it may NOT be applied to.

NOT_REACHABLE.asserts: no caller can reach this path
NOT_REACHABLE.note: requires a source that claims to enumerate callers; without one the assertion is a guess

COMPENSATING_CONTROL_PRESENT.asserts: a control outside this path stops the consequence
COMPENSATING_CONTROL_PRESENT.note: control_ref must name something checkable: a path_id in this inventory or an artifact path

DATA_NOT_SENSITIVE.asserts: the data on this path cannot cause the harm the flow carries
DATA_NOT_SENSITIVE.note: the code most likely to be a lie; forbidden on the two classes where it is almost always false

TEST_ONLY.asserts: the path is reachable only from test code
TEST_ONLY.note: a test-only payment path is a production payment path with a hopeful label

OWNER_ACCEPTS.asserts: a named party accepts the residual risk of this path
OWNER_ACCEPTS.note: the only code that transfers risk to a person; it needs a person and an expiry

unclassified_class_rule: a path whose class is unknown may not be excluded with DATA_NOT_SENSITIVE: the class is exactly what the code asserts to know
